name: restructure
description: Reorganise the map in one batch. Each op is one of: move (node_id under parent_id, optional after_id); merge (fold node_ids into into_id: bodies appended, sources and children kept, links rewired); regroup (create a new parent titled title under parent_id, default the nodes' common parent, and move node_ids under it; set ref to name it); rename (node_id to title); retire (remove node_id and its subtree; it can be undone). Moves that would create a cycle are rejected. Give a one-sentence reason; reviewers see it. Organiser runs are usually in propose mode, so this becomes a proposal.

node_ids.description: merge: nodes folded into into_id. regroup: nodes to move under the new parent.

parent_id.description: move: new parent. regroup: where the new parent goes.

after_id.description: move: place after this sibling. Default last.

title.description: rename: new title. regroup: title of the new parent.

kind.description: regroup: kind of the new parent. Default topic.

ref.description: regroup: label for the new parent, usable later as @ref.
